title: ARM AArch64 (ARMv8) instruction encoding
summary: AArch64 (ARM 64-bit) instructions are 4 bytes, 4-byte aligned. Major classes: data processing (immediate/register), load/store, branch, system. Encoding: bits 28-31 often indicate the class. Data processing (register): 11010110 (RET) etc. Load/store: 11100100 (STUR) etc. Branch: 000101 (B) etc. 31 registers (x0-x30) + SP + XZR (zero register).

structure.meaning: sf(1) | op(1) | S(1) | 100010 | sh(1) | imm12(12) | Rn(5) | Rd(5). E.g., ADDI, SUBI, ANDI, ORRI.
sf(1) | op(1) | S(1) | 01010 | shift(2) | 0 | Rm(5) | imm6(6) | Rn(5) | Rd(5). E.g., ADD, SUB, AND, ORR, EOR.
size(2) | 111 | V(1) | 00 | opc(2) | 1 | Rm(5) | option(3) | S(1) | 10 | Rn(5) | Rt(5). E.g., LDR, STR, LDP, STP.
size(2) | 111 | V(1) | 00 | opc(2) | 0 | imm9(9) | 01 | Rn(5) | Rt(5). E.g., LDR (immediate offset).
000101 | imm26(26). B (branch) or BL (branch with link).
01010100 | imm19(19) | 0 | cond(4). B.cond (BEQ, BNE, BLT, etc.).
1101010100 | op1(3) | CRn(4) | CRm(4) | op2(3) | Rt(5). MRS, MSR, SVC, HVC, SMC.
x0-x30 (general-purpose), SP (stack pointer), XZR (zero register, read-as-zero). w0-w30 are 32-bit views. v0-v31 are 128-bit SIMD/FP registers.

notes: AArch64 (ARM 64-bit) is the 64-bit execution state of ARMv8+.
AArch32 (ARM 32-bit) is the 32-bit execution state (ARMv7 compatibility).
ARM uses condition codes (EQ, NE, CS, CC, MI, PL, VS, VC, HI, LS, GE, LT, GT, LE, AL) on many instructions.
ARM has 31 general-purpose registers + SP + PC (not directly accessible).
